children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Triage failed starts, storage and network faults, login problems, backup failures, and module synchronization with one evidence-first workflow.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Capture the resource UID, cluster, namespace, time range, events, conditions, and relevant logs before changing state.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Start with desired spec and observed status, then correlate events, workload state, component logs, audit records, and recent changes.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Record exact timestamps and timezone for every exported source.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Separate Gameplane API/operator failures from game-container failures.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Preserve the first error; later retries often hide the original cause.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Classify the symptom before choosing a runbook: Pending, image pull, crash loop, probe, volume, service, auth, backup, source sync, or tunnel not ready.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Pending usually points to capacity, placement, PVC, or scheduling policy.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: No console output can mean the container never started or the game stream is not ready.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Restore and module failures require destination/source credentials and controller logs.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: When local checks are exhausted, share a minimal reproducible case without secrets, tokens, world data, or player information.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Spec → status/conditions → events → workload and PVC/service state

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  API/operator logs → container logs → game logs → audit history

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Recent change → safe rollback → sanitized support bundle
